text: Meta shows you every ad running right now. Search 'cafe' in India: twenty-five thousand results.
Amazon. Blinkit. A mobile game. None of them need you.
So I searched for what a small business writes instead.
Walk-ins welcome. A hundred and ten ads. Tattoo studios, camera shops.
Keep only the ones with no working site. A hundred and sixty-six ads become fourteen.
All of them already paying to be seen.
